report.explanation: Operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors is not supported by current telemetry. Traces show all checkout, order, payment, inventory and postgres spans returning 200 with no errors. Metrics show order v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders 200s with zero 502s; v2.0.0 shows zero traffic. Deployment record only proves version facts. No evidence establishes a bounded cause; hand off.
missing_evidence: Error/failed traces or logs showing actual checkout failures (logs excluded from context)
Metrics or logs demonstrating error rate increase on checkout/order routes
Deployment timeline correlating a version change with any observed error onset
Evidence of resource saturation (db pool, redis latency) if errors exist
